_comment: How the `medium` column is classified. Cinemas are recognised by a prefix (e.g. 'Cinéma Prince Charles'); media containing a physical keyword are physical (Blu-ray); everything else is home viewing (streaming/TV/VOD) unless listed in cinemaOverrides.

posters._comment: 'original': poster in the film's original language when it is English or French, otherwise the international (English) poster. 'always-original': original language whenever available.

_venueNames: Display name overrides, applied after the 'Cinéma' prefix is removed (e.g. the sheet says 'Cinéma Prince Charles', the cinema is called 'Prince Charles Cinema').
_festivalKeywords: A comment tag counts as a festival when it contains one of these words (case- and accent-insensitive). Add festivals whose name doesn't say 'festival', like PIFFF.
_siteUrl: The public address of the site, with a trailing slash. Used for the canonical link and social previews (they need absolute URLs).
